The unexpected encounter between these two opens the door to new heroes.

data.synopsis:
In a crowded train where desire flows, a hooded man, Kiichi Kusakabe, stands in silence. His piercing eyes see through fantasies and his exceptional hand skills lead women to pleasure.

Iori Fudo, a student at Reimeikan University, doubts the existence of sexual abusers (chikan). "How can something like that exist? That's just an urban legend," she said. While researching their existence, she herself became a victim of a sexual abuser, but was saved by Kiichi Kusakabe, who is also one of them.

data.synopsis:
The World of Immortals, it is the world every mortals long for. For many, it is an eternal glory to distort the dimension and enter the World of Immortals. But the vicissitude of time is simply merciless, the legends regarding immortality had long been forgotten. However, a miracle shall rise once more! An immortal was about to distort the dimension with martial arts and cut all ties with the mortal world. The protagonist, Xiao Chen, was caught up in it and accidentally brought to the World of Immortals. What will they find in the vast world beyond the rift?

data.synopsis:
This is a compilation of the matches from Inazuma Eleven Football Frontier, the first game in the Inazuma Eleven series.
The Raimon Junior High soccer team, led by the protagonist Endou Mamoru, aims to win the national tournament, Football Frontier.
Thanks to the efforts of legendary striker Gouenji Shuya, who joins the team, they beat strong schools and make it through the regional qualifiers despite fierce battles. With their former rival, Teikoku Gakuen's genius game maker Kidou Arihito, now on board, Raimon Junior High School advances to the finals, but they are faced with the overwhelming strength of Zeus Junior High!

(Source: Official Website)

data.synopsis:
Cao Yanbing and his group are framed by the God Martial Spirit Legion led by Huangfu Longdou after the destruction of the Reed Catkins Tower, and they are all wanted by the Spirit World. Later, in order to find out the whereabouts of his mother, Cao Yanbing deliberately gets captured in the death prison “Qianji Black Rakshasa”, which is guarded by Hall of Fame. To save Cao Yanbing, his companions gather support from various sides, and all forces converge on Hall of Fame, launching an extraordinary battle of the elite.

It's time for battle! It's time for excitement! It's time for thrills! "This trial has a 98% mortality rate." "Then... I'll eliminate everyone who threatens my life." Luo Feng travels to the Blood Continent for the trial to protect Earth. On this continent, he constantly pushes his limits, makes good friends and encounters powerful enemies, but he never retreats. Instead, he perseveres step by step, carrying the burden of his journey. Ultimately, he completes his infinite advancement, gaining the powerful ability to protect Earth.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

data.title: Quanqiu Gao Wu
data.synopsis:
The 28-year-old Fang Ping was accidentally reborn in a parallel world in 2008, returning to his 18-year-old high school self. This is a world composed of a warrior system, where warriors have extremely high social status and rights. Due to the coincidence of fate with Emperor Zhan Tian in his previous life, a martial arts system was generated in Fang Ping's body after his rebirth. He can convert rare props of any value into martial arts value by touching them, and improve a series of abilities such as bones, tendons, flesh, blood, and mental strength at a speed beyond ordinary people. Through the system's golden finger and his own mind, Fang Ping successfully entered Modu Wuke University for further studies, and in the years to come, he continued to complete his self-growth. Faced with unknown difficulties, he gradually realized the responsibilities that warriors need to bear and the mission of protecting family, friendship, and love.

(Source: Tencent, Google translated)

data.synopsis:
Every second counts when you're a first responder. But what if you could see a glimpse into the future? Hosu is a firefighter with the supernatural ability to do just that. There’s just one catch. It only works when he feels extreme stress under pressure. Will knowing what will happen ahead of time help Hosu extinguish fires before they completely destroy homes and lives? And will he learn to wield his ability when he needs it most?

data.synopsis: Cute friends Runa, Raina and Miyu study at the prestigious private school Etoile and spend a lot of time together doing a variety of teenage activities. As members of a journalism club, the girls downloaded an app called Angel Maker, which proved challenging. It was cursed by fallen angels, and the girlfriends received magical powers. As they say, with new power comes new responsibility. Ugly monsters sensed the newfound magic, and from that moment began the tireless struggle of brave magical girls for goodness and justice.

data.title_japanese: ありふれた職業で世界最強 ピクチャードラマ
data.synopsis:
An online motion graphic spin-off series that provides a comedic interpretation of events that have occurred in conjunction with the Anime. These episodes were originally posted on the official Twitter page on a weekly basis that coincided with the debut of each of the anime's episodes, and were later included in the Blu-ray BOX sets. The voice cast for the Picture Dramas is the same as the Anime cast.

(Source: Arifureta Wiki)
